## Context / Problem
ADR 0101 and the author-facing plan guide make `[non-codebase]` canonical while retaining `[operator-attested]` only as an undocumented compatibility alias. Closed migration story `unbeatable-unlit-gadwall` updated other user-visible remediation strings, but `operator_evidence_issues` still tells plan authors to add the legacy tag. Review result `a64d1c8b-0ed6-445c-ae31-f20f4a97312d` on `synonymous-senatorial-cuscus` reproduced the stale advice and caused an author to write both tags.

## Approach
Change only user-facing P6 coaching to prescribe `[non-codebase]`. Preserve the dual-token matcher and internal historical Python identifiers required for compatibility by ADR 0101. Add a regression assertion on the emitted coaching, then sweep active author-facing plan-review strings for the same stale prescription.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py` — replace the stale emitted remediation and align its author-facing docstrings/comments.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_advisory.py` — align the adjacent author-facing comment if retained.
- `tests/unit/test_plan_review_portability.py` — assert coaching asks for the canonical tag and does not prescribe the legacy alias.

## Testing
- Happy path: `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_portability.py` proves an untagged live outcome is coached to use `[non-codebase]`.
- Compatibility edge: focused matcher tests continue proving both exact spellings parse, while malformed near-misses do not.
- Sweep: `rg -n "prefix.*operator-attested|not tagged \[operator-attested\]" src/rebar/llm/plan_review` returns no active author-facing prescription.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] P6 feedback for an untagged outside-world criterion explicitly asks for `[non-codebase]`; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_portability.py`.
- [x] The compatibility matcher still accepts existing `[operator-attested]` tickets; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_non_codebase_tag.py`.
- [x] Active plan-review coaching contains no instruction to author new `[operator-attested]` tags; checked by the scoped `rg` sweep.
